observations: Photo 0: Front view of a white microwave with a glass door, two control knobs, and a small logo on the bottom left. The interior has a glass turntable. The background includes a wall with decorative signs and a box labeled '2 cm/32'.

Photo 1: Front view with door open, showing the interior. The control panel has two knobs: one for power (Low, Med, High) and one for timer (0-60 minutes). The interior is clean with a glass turntable. A red warning label is visible on the door frame.
Photo 2: Interior view with door open, showing the empty cavity, glass turntable, and a warning label. The door has a barcode and text. The control panel is visible on the right side.

Photo 3: Close-up of the control panel showing the power and timer settings. The power knob has settings for Low, Med, High, and M.Low/M.High. The timer knob has settings from 0 to 60 minutes. The brand name is not visible in any photo.
All photos show a watermark 'YULGO ENTERPRISES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.claim: UK used George Home 20L Microwave oven
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.

risks.risk: The microwave may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the microwave turning on, heating a cup of water, and defrosting a frozen item.

risks.risk: The microwave may have hidden wear or damage to the interior or exterior not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the interior walls, door seal, and exterior edges for scratches, dents, or mold.

risks.risk: The microwave may not be from the UK or may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the original UK receipt or a label showing the country of origin and serial number.

proof_requests: Video of the microwave in operation: heating water and defrosting.
Close-up video of the interior and exterior for damage.
Photo of the original UK receipt or label with serial number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
